title: Weighted Inverse Lax-Wendroff Boundary Treatment of Discontinuous Galerkin Methods for Conservation Laws
summary: In this paper, we propose a weighted inverse Lax-Wendroff (WILW) boundary treatment for the discontinuous Galerkin (DG) method on unfitted meshes to efficiently solve hyperbolic conservation laws in complex geometries. The proposed method employs the standard DG scheme for interior cells and reconstructs high-order approximation polynomials via the ILW principle for cut cells near boundaries to impose numerical boundary conditions, effectively eliminating the time-step restriction typically caused by small cut cells.
